name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump's campaign tour continues as Republicans rally voters ahead of midterms, Ukraine faces limited access to Starshield technology, Houthi rebels hit Saudi oil company building.

changes.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over. (Image credit: Alberto Pezzali).

changes.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries as relations with Trump sour
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over amid deepening tensions with Washington.

changes.title: Why Russia Sees a Window to Bomb Ukraine Into Submission This Winter
changes.summary: Moscow is not winning on the battlefield. Instead, it is seizing an opening to inflict immense human suffering in Ukrainian cities.

changes.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed overt frustration with the United States in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.

changes.title: What Is Starshield, SpaceX’s Military-Grade Satellite Internet Service Ukraine Relies On?
changes.summary: For years, Ukraine’s armed forces have relied on satellite communication services developed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX. Recent restrictions have hampered its war effort.

changes.title: How Starlink disruptions affected Ukraine's battlefield operations
changes.summary: A key component of Ukraine's communications network was partially disabled on Wednesday. The Starshield satellite network, funded by the Pentagon and operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX, was not operating at full capacity, hampering communications within the Ukrainian military. Liz Landers reports and Amna Nawaz discusses t.

changes.title: Sudden Starlink limits sap Ukraine drone power as Kyiv fears U.S. intelligence squeeze
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones lost some of their fighting capacity after restrictions were suddenly imposed on the battlefield use of the country's U.S.-made Starlink communication terminals, officials said Wednesday as the capital endured another night of missile attacks.

changes.title: U.S. Continues to Provide Intelligence to Ukraine, Officials Say
changes.summary: Confusion about the U.S. stance has mounted in Kyiv amid restrictions on how the military version of Starlink is used.

changes.title: Ukraine’s Exposure Grows as Satellite Use Is Restricted and Russia Escalates
changes.summary: A huge attack cut power to 600,000 people in Kyiv, and a Pentagon-funded satellite internet program appeared to be curbed without warning.
